title.zh:
把今日写下，
让来日重逢。
title.en:
Write today down,
meet it again later.

lead.zh: 先留下真实的一点。日子不必写完整，重要的是它能在之后被你找回来。
lead.en: Start with one true thing. A day does not need to be complete to be worth finding again.

emptyBody.zh: 从一句话开始也可以。先把此刻交给之后的自己。
emptyBody.en: One sentence is enough. Leave this moment for your later self.

recentEmpty.en: There is no page to show yet.

importBody.zh: 把旧日记带进来；原始文件不会被修改。
importBody.en: Bring in old pages; the original files stay unchanged.

errorBody.zh: 真实数据没有读到，所以这里不会用一组数字来代替。
errorBody.en: The real data could not be read, so this page will not substitute made-up numbers.

drafting.zh: 尚未收笔，改动只留在此处
drafting.en: Not saved yet; changes stay here

failed.zh: 保存失败，草稿仍在本机
failed.en: Save failed; the draft is still on this device

offline.zh: 暂时无法保存，草稿仍在本机
offline.en: Saving is unavailable; the draft is still on this device

note.zh: 自动草稿只留在本机；正式保存后，这一页会进入今朝、流年和寻迹。
note.en: Autosaved drafts stay on this device; a committed save appears in Today, Journal, and Search.

leave.zh: 还有未保存的改动。要先留下本地草稿并离开吗？
leave.en: There are unsaved changes. Leave after keeping the local draft?

title.zh: 翻开你真正写过的日子。
title.en: Open the days you actually wrote.

emptyBody.zh: 等你留下第一篇文字，它就从这里开始。也可以把旧日记带回来。
emptyBody.en: It begins with the first page you leave here. You can also bring in old journals.

noText.zh: 这一页还没有可读正文。
noText.en: This page has no readable text yet.

errorBody.zh: 原文没有被替换；请重试，或回到流年选择另一页。
errorBody.en: The source was not changed. Try again or choose another page.

title.zh: 在写过的文字里找回一段过去。
title.en: Find a moment in what you wrote.

lead.zh: 搜索只穿过你的原始日记和周记；结果会直接回到那一页。
lead.en: Search crosses your original journals and returns directly to the source page.

placeholder.zh: 一句话、一个人、一个地方…

emptyTitle.en: Search begins with your first line

emptyBody.zh: 现在还没有可搜索的记录。去落笔，或迎回旧日。
emptyBody.en: There are no searchable pages yet. Write today or bring in old pages.

summary.zh: 找到 {count} 处相合的文字

none.zh: 这一回没有找到相合的文字。换个说法，或去流年里看看。
none.en: Nothing matched this time. Try another phrase or browse the journal.

kicker.zh: 近思 · 只从你的文字出发

placeholder.zh: 例如：我什么时候开始真正重视产品？
placeholder.en: For example: When did I start caring deeply about product?

insufficient.zh: 还没有足够的文字支持这个判断。
insufficient.en: There is not enough writing to support this judgment yet.

insufficientBody.zh: 你可以先继续记录；等文字变多，再回来问同一个问题。
insufficientBody.en: Keep writing and return to the same question when there is more to work with.

unknownBody.zh: 没有被这些记录写下的部分，近思不会替你补上。
unknownBody.en: What these records do not say remains uncertain.

error.zh: 近思暂时没有完成，请稍后再试。
error.en: Reflection could not finish. Please try again.
